correctness.rationale: The complete 14-page Myroshnychenko–Ryabogin–Saroglou 2026 full text was read; Lemmas 4.8 and 4.12 together rule out every even spherical degree at least 2 by forbidden circle frequency 2 and every odd degree at least 5 by frequency 5 under q=3, retaining 0,1,3. The classical Maxwell multipole factorization of a nonzero real harmonic cubic has three unordered axes with multiplicities. On a plane with complex null vector m=p+iq, the third support-function Fourier coefficient is P(m)/8; the standard support area integral gives πr²−π|P(m)|²/4. Nullity m·m=0 removes the harmonic projection trace, and |v·m|²=1−(n·v)² proves the exact product for every unit normal. Zero product is exactly circular shadow; sufficiently small nonzero cubic amplitude makes the spherical curvature positive for any prescribed triple. Independent symbolic checks recomputed harmonicity, null-quadratic factor and repeated/orthogonal-axis sextic cases; finite diagnostics do not establish these analytic universal claims.
residual_risks: Finite diagnostics alone cannot prove the universal aspects; the cited arguments supply those steps.
